title: These 10+ Games Are Coming To Xbox Next Week (November 16-20)

Manage Topics News Xbox Microsoft Xbox Series X Xbox Series S New Releases These 10+ Games Are Coming To Xbox Next Week (November 16-20) Nothing particularly interesting, eh? by Fraser Gilbert 2 hours ago Share: Welcome to your Xbox games roundup for November 16-20 ! The big release of the week (and the year, and the decade, and of all time) is obviously GTA 6 , but there are some other interesting titles on the way including Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator and Vice: Magic City Mayhem , plus some more Xbox Game Pass goodness! Here's what's coming to Xbox next week: On this page: These 10+ Games Are Coming To Xbox Next Week (November 16-20) 1. New Xbox Releases (November 16-20) 2. Xbox Game Pass Titles New Xbox Releases (November 16-20) Watch on YouTube Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator (November 17): "In Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator, you take on the everyday responsibilities of a real park ranger in the stunning Faremont National Park. Restore and maintain scenic trails, assist visitors, and document wildlife in a living, breathing ecosystem." Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic (November 17): "Create your own first-year student at the academy and call upon the help of Unicorn Academy’s favorite characters. Groom, race and bond with your unicorn. Embark on missions to stop Ravenzella’s evil plot." Dark Rail (November 18): "Send your inquisitors out by train on deadly quests to hunt down heretics across the frontier. These expeditions cost vital supplies, can raise madness and revolt, and may leave your inquisitors wounded or broken, but they are necessary. The prisoner shipments must never stop, no matter the cost." Vice: Magic City Mayhem (November 18): "Vice: Magic City Mayhem is a top-down 8-bit retro action/adventure game inspired by Zelda with a Vice City theme." GTA 6 (November 19): "Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive." The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ Online (November 19): "For the first time ever on console, descend together. The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ brings the complete game to console with full online cooperative play for up to four players. Every character, every item, every path, every ending, now with friends online." Time Machine: Hidden Objects (November 19): "Are you brave enough to step inside a time machine and rewrite history? Welcome to a captivating hidden object adventure that takes you on an unforgettable journey through space and time." Cats in Wonderland (November 20): "Cats in Wonderland is a hidden object game where you need to find all the hidden cats in Wonderland. Explore the maps, find items to access new areas, and gather the resistance to defeat the Queen of Hearts." Drill Drill Drill (November 20): "DRILL DRILL DRILL is a pixel art cave-diving adventure where every floor brings new dangers, precious crystals, and a giant statue that wants to eat the very well you’re trying to escape through." Geo Book (November 20): "Travel across continents, discover fascinating places, challenge your memory and put your geographical knowledge to the test through a variety of exciting mini-games." ReactorX 4 (November 20): "The continuation of the adventures of the space saga ReactorX ! A robot technician and captain, flying through an asteroid field, receive a mysterious SOS signal with a “request for help.” Ritebound (November 20): "2D platformer in which players must lead a group of cultists to a mysterious portal. On each level, the cultists must reach the portal, which may be located on the other side of a chasm, behind a series of obstacles, or high above their current position." Tanks Sweet Tanks (November 20): "Defeat the enemy tanks while dodging their deadly bullets. Improve your aim and maneuver skill while war itself is trying to end your adventure. Level by level the enemy's tanks get faster, smarter, and deadlier." Xbox Game Pass Titles Watch on YouTube Note: We expect more Xbox Game Pass titles to be announced for next week in the near future.
